api_base_url: https://registry.mbr.mt/ ; https://baros.mbr.mt/ (online registry; WAF-blocked for automation)
license: Public register (free basic search; documents paid; reuse terms unclear)
notes: Authoritative company register (English; no account for basic search). FREE basic company search by name/registration number; certified documents PAID (EUR 5-25). Register holds basic info, OFFICERS (directors/secretary), SHAREHOLDERS (name, share type, degree of control), FINANCIAL info (annual accounts, annual return) and status. BUT the online registry portals (registry.mbr.mt, baros.mbr.mt) return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (WAF) -> automated/bulk access blocked. No open bulk export. Recommended for MANUAL lookups. Keyed on the registration number (C prefix for companies).

source_name: MBR annual accounts / annual return (financial statements)
notes: Companies file annual accounts (under the Companies Act / IFRS or GAPSME for small companies) + annual return to the MBR. Public but accessed as PAID documents (EUR 5-25 per document) - NOT structured open data. Small companies file abridged accounts. Document-based PDF; structured figures need OCR/parsing or a commercial provider / the paid MBR API. Join on registration number. EUR.

source_name: MBR API packages (Company Search API, etc.)
notes: The MBR has launched official API packages (e.g. a Company Search API) for digital service delivery. These are SUBSCRIPTION/paid packages requiring registration + payment - the sanctioned automation path (the free web search is WAF-blocked for bots). Returns structured company data (name, registration, officers, shareholders, financial info). Paid; per-package terms.

fields_observed: beneficial owners (name, nationality, extent/nature of beneficial interest)
notes: Register of beneficial owners (5AMLD). General public access withdrawn after the 2022 CJEU ruling; since July 2025 access for those demonstrating a LEGITIMATE INTEREST (without alerting the company). Not open bulk. Join on registration number. Personal data (GDPR). Noted for completeness.

Maltese VAT number (MT + 8 digits) is separate from the registration number. Validate via VIES (or CFR). Validation only; does not enumerate companies. The registration number is the register key; VAT must be sourced/validated separately.

National open-data portal. Verified: returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (WAF) and the standard CKAN/DKAN/uData API paths return 404 - non-standard custom portal. Does NOT publish the company register/financials as open bulk. Discovery/context only; resolve via the portal UI.

Vendors resell the MBR register + parsed annual accounts + officers/shareholders. A realistic path to STRUCTURED financials + bulk at scale (alongside the paid MBR API), since the MBR has no open bulk and the free search is WAF-blocked. Proprietary, paid, per contract.
